description: The single structured object the model returns for one reel.

description.description: One or two neutral sentences about what the evidence shows.
description.title: Description

evidence_basis.description: Only the evidence types that actually support the verdict.
evidence_basis.title: Evidence Basis

format.description: For example: tutorial, skit, vlog, ad.
format.title: Format

hook.description: Opening hook, only if the first second was observed; else empty.
hook.title: Hook

is_ad.description: True when the reel is an advertisement.
is_ad.title: Is Ad

on_screen_text.description: Text visible in the frames, or empty.
on_screen_text.title: On Screen Text

reason.description: One sentence, in terms of what the person said they want.
reason.title: Reason

topics.description: Up to five short topic labels.
topics.title: Topics

transcript.description: Words actually heard in the audio clip. Empty when no clip was provided or no intelligible speech was heard. Never on-screen text.
transcript.title: Transcript

value_ids.description: IDs of the approved values relied on. Empty when neutral.
value_ids.title: Value Ids

verdict.description: Relative to the approved values only.
verdict.title: Verdict

title: ModelJudgment
